accessBasis.gate: Purchase register view/create rights are resolved separately (the register screen renders 'You do not have permission to view this register.'), on top of the voucher_creation_mobile feature.

behaviourReviewed: The purchase form is the same InvoiceSummaryScreen with invoiceType 'purchase'; its titles, number and date labels all switch on that flag.
References captured: Supplier Invoice No. and its date, Buyer PO No. and PO date (behind a company switch), Other Ref, Terms of Delivery, and the Purchase Ledger selector.

The detail screen carries an explicit Tally state line — Syncing to Tally… / Synced to Tally / Tally sync failed — with a Re-sync to Tally action that resends the invoice's current values on the next sync.
Update Payment Status asks 'Which account paid?' whenever the paid amount increases, and aborts the status change if the payment insert fails ('Payment status was left unchanged.').
Cancel Invoice keeps the record and marks it cancelled; it is refused for invoices carrying an e-invoice or e-way bill.
Editing is refused for invoices with fractional GST rates.
Voucher number can be corrected on its own via Edit Voucher Number.
inventoryDeviations: The inventory names only purchase_invoice_register_screen.dart and purchase_invoice_detail_screen.dart. Neither contains the creation form — a purchase invoice is created through add_invoice_items_screen.dart and invoice_summary_screen.dart in 'purchase' mode. Both were read and quoted; topics.json sourceFiles was left untouched (another agent owns it).
deliberatelyOmitted: The maker-checker save modes (voucher_approvals is dark in the prod evidence).
Purchase import / supplier-line-description behaviour: purchase_import_supplier_line_description and purchase_order_import are is_customer_visible = false, so no import procedure was written here.
No tax advice; the GST explanation is delegated to the gst-on-the-bill guide.
